stats.limitation: Official pedestrian source XY accuracy 1m/Z accuracy 2m and approximate cross-source vertical agreement; sampling is not a surveyed road design. Unmatched bridge/tunnel levels retain a weak prior and should be checked against local terrain/structure. No layer number is converted into an elevation.

surface_height_note: Road top = profile reference z + 0.15m. Both edges at each station share the same height; create a common junction patch only for existing shared source nodes.
terrain_note: Reference-based profile fit permits local cut/fill around genuinely visible road surfaces; do not join unrelated layered crossings. Keep underground and indoor routes hidden as references.
